answer: Chartmaker painted globe warrant filed with the coast register turns identity into something scarce. Because each painted globe is a year of tide tables in the guild ledger, so a farm must chart a hundred real coasts by hand, the ocean of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. The defender's bill stays flat — one quick verification per account — while the attacker's bill climbs with every clone, and the vine is that asymmetry in plain numbers. The karst is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
